instruction: Create a compressed archive named "essay_submission.zip" in /home/user containing both the original essay file "Recruitment_and_retention_of_health_professionals_across_Europe.docx" and its PDF version.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a ZIP archive containing both a .docx file and its PDF version. Evaluator checks if the ZIP exists and contains files with both .docx and .pdf extensions (at least 2 files total). This verifies multi-step operations: export to PDF and create ZIP archive.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts ZIP file list from the specified path (/home/user/essay_submission.zip)
Metric logic correctly verifies ZIP existence, minimum file count (2 files), and required extensions (.docx and .pdf)
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies both requirements (original .docx AND its PDF version)
Extension checking is robust: handles case-insensitivity, proper extension extraction, and set-based comparison
Expected values are semantically correct: requires both .docx and .pdf extensions with minimum 2 files
Error handling is appropriate: returns {'exists': False, 'files': []} when ZIP doesn't exist or cannot be read
Data flow is correct: getter extracts file list -> metric checks extensions and count -> returns binary score
